patthana20.8:1.1: na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:2.1: na na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo ca na dassanena pahātabbo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.8:3.1: na dassanena pahātabbañca na na dassanena pahātabbañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:4.1: hetuyā pañca. nabhāvanāyapahātabbaduke bhāvanāyapahātabbadukaṃ na bhāvanāyapahātabbaṃ
patthana20.8:5.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.8:7.1: na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.8:9.1: na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.8:11.1: na savitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na savitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na savitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakko ca avitakko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.8:12.1: na avitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na avitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na avitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakko ca avitakko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.8:13.1: na savitakkañca na avitakkañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na savitakkañca na avitakkañca dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na savitakkañca na avitakkañca dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakko ca avitakko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.8:15.1: na savicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca savicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.8:17.1: na sappītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappītiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.8:19.1: na pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.8:21.1: na sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.8:23.1: na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naupekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato ca naupekkhāsahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.8:24.1: na naupekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naupekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. na upekkhāsahagatañca na
patthana20.8:25.1: naupekkhāsahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na upekkhāsahagatañca na naupekkhāsahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca naupekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na upekkhāsahagatañca na naupekkhāsahagatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato ca naupekkhāsahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.8:27.1: na kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kāmāvacaro ca nakāmāvacaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.8:28.1: na nakāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. na kāmāvacarañca na
patthana20.8:29.1: nakāmāvacarañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nakāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.8:31.1: na rūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca rūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.8:33.1: na arūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na arūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.8:35.1: na pariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.8:36.1: na apariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:37.1: na pariyāpannañca na apariyāpannañca dhammaṃ paṭicca pariyāpanno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:39.1: na niyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:40.1: na aniyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.8:41.1: na niyyānikañca na aniyyānikañca dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:43.1: na niyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:44.1: na aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.8:45.1: na niyatañca na aniyatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:47.1: na sauttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sauttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na sauttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na sauttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sauttaro ca anuttaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.8:48.1: na anuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sauttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.8:49.1: na sauttarañca na anuttarañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sauttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
